title: Detected nonempty Fourier frequencies
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, and let the failure parameter be rational and lie in $(0,1/2]$. Given a batch of restricted examples, the detected frequencies are those members $S$ of the low-degree junta Fourier family that are nonempty and whose coefficient estimate, computed using $S$ as a member of that family, has absolute value at least the detection threshold for $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$
The failure parameter is rational and lies in $(0,1/2]$
The batch is a function on the indices up to the restricted sample count, with each value an assignment on coordinates outside $P$ paired with a sign
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the detection threshold or empirical coefficient estimator, so their exact formulas cannot be rendered.
